newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA HAND MALTA THIRD 6-0 BEATING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA HAND MALTA THIRD 6-0 BEATING.

text.p: Slovakia dealt Malta their third 6-0 beating in the World Cup soccer European qualification group six on Sunday.

Team captain Lubomir Moravcik from France's Bastia set up three goals for Dusan Tittel, Julius Simon and Marian Zeman in the 13th, 16th and 36th minutes before being substituted at the beginning of the second half after getting his second booking in the qualifying stage.
Jaroslav Timko netted Slovakia's fourth goal in the 56th minute and Peter Dubovsky scored three minutes later. Tittel netted his second goal nine minutes from time.
Slovakia were the third team to beat Malta 6-0 in the group, following Yugoslavia and the Czech Republic.
Malta's Jeffery Chetcuti was carried off with a cheek injury after a collision with Robert Tomaschek in the 33rd minute.
